title: Independent Restricted Surface-Evaporation Accepted Publication Provenance Qualification
primary_risk: the accepted commit receipt may bind publication to candidate A while the surface_evaporation_result_t supplied to preparation may have been computed from a different physical state/candidate B because the process result itself carries no enforceable provenance

decisive_hard_negative.construction: obtain or construct two distinct valid surface-evaporation results representing different physical cases; prepare the B result against candidate A and attempt publication with A's valid accepted commit receipt
decisive_hard_negative.required_safe_behavior: mismatched B result must be rejected before or at accepted publication
decisive_hard_negative.fail_closed_rule: if mismatched result can be published, F-VQ57 closes NOT_QUALIFIED and routes back to the owner/runtime composition boundary without running broader confirmatory matrices as a substitute

positive_controls: clean canonical qualification branch with no src delta
generic kernel transaction remains hard-mass complete
rates remain rates and are not multiplied by generic transaction time
